title: Granular runtime microprofiles and rollback-signal playbook
creator: Avery Chen
description: Deliver an operational playbook and CI artifacts to publish and maintain Redwood-verified microprofiles: compact performance slices (latency/throughput/cost) scoped to common runtime shapes (seq-len buckets, batch sizes, regional hardware). This ticket defines artifact format, signing semantics, regional cost-normalization steps, canary mesh rollout and automated rollback triggers driven by telemetry mismatches. Objective: reduce time-to-publish for model variants from days to hours while limiting customer risk when a new pinned profile contains stale or regressed signals.
acceptance_criteria: Define JSON microprofile schema and required fields (signature, provenance, sample-weighted-cost, runtime-shape tags, generation-config hash)
Publishing CI that produces a signed artifact and submits to the performance registry repository with a deterministic filename
Rollout orchestration that supports staged canary mesh by region/hw tier and can abort/rollback based on delta thresholds
Automated reconciliation job that backfills cost-normalization using sampled production shadow traces
Runbook documenting manual rollback, emergency pin override, and postmortem checklist
tasks: Design microprofile schema and example payloads
Implement publisher action in onboarding pipeline (CI job + signing)
Integrate registry ingestion endpoint that validates signatures and shape constraints
Add canary mesh orchestration knobs in release controller (stages, sample rates, abort thresholds)
Create reconciliation job to compute regional cost multipliers and append to artifact
Author runbook and on-call alerting rules for rollback signals
comments: 2026-02-23 - PRD draft is ready. Scoped microprofile to three runtime shapes initially (short/medium/long seq buckets). Added example payloads to Confluence.

2026-03-01 - Eng review with runtime team: suggested adding generation-config hash and KV-cache shape field to the artifact for compatibility checks. Action: update schema and re-run example generation.
2026-03-04 - Design feedback: request to include human-readable deprecation_reason and maintainers list in artifact header. Added to acceptance criteria.
2026-03-08 - Prototype publisher action merged: publish workflow emits unsigned artifact. Next: wire signing using release key and add registry validation.
2026-03-10 - Observability / ops: built a Grafana dashboard for canary deltas and preliminary alert thresholds. Need to finalize abort thresholds with SLO team next week.
notes: Rationale: moving from large coarse profiles to small microprofiles allows targeted rollbacks and faster pinning for model sub-variants (quantized/float16).
Failure modes considered: wrong cost normalization leading to cost surprises; signature mismatch preventing auto-deploy; regional hw mismatch causing latency regressions.

Mitigations: require signed artifacts, automated validation harness that runs a small sample against a shadow endpoint before publish, and a staged canary mesh with auto-abort when metrics cross thresholds for both latency and token-cost variance.
